XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-0
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: The day doesn't ask anything of you yet. It just waits, warm and unhurried, while you remember who you've become.

XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-1
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: The first task of the day is one you'd do for free — and they pay you well for it. Strange and wonderful, how the intention held: my own design studio, with clients who trust my eye.

XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-2
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: The air outside smells faintly of rain that already fell. Everything is rinsed, including — somehow — you.

XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-3
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: You decline a shiny thing that isn't yours to do, and the calendar breathes. Mastery is mostly subtraction, you've learned.

XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-4
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: Someone younger watches how you move through the day and quietly adjusts their own sails. You remember being them. You'd have loved proof like you.

XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-5
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: Somewhere in the day you feel it land — that this was once the dream. This exact, ordinary, extraordinary Tuesday. You feel proud, all the way through.

XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-6
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: There is proof behind this memory now: Sent my portfolio to two studios I admire. It is small enough to be real, and real enough to change what comes next.

XCUIElementTypeButton.name: story-listen-from-7
XCUIElementTypeButton.label: You set tomorrow's one intention like a cup by the kettle, then let the day go completely. Sleep comes down like warm weather.
